## Content and Safety Check / 内容与安全确认

- [ ] The request is for hypothetical simulation, speculative fiction, or product functionality.
- [ ] It does not require real-person defamation, harassment, impersonation, privacy leakage, or unlawful instructions.
- [ ] It does not include secrets, API keys, Authorization headers, user identifiers, or personal data.

- [ ] 该请求用于假设性推演、speculative fiction 或产品功能。
